title: Latency weekly: firebreak agenda + follow-ups (scratch)
content:
Context / purpose:
- Quick, focused sync for the serving runtime weekly: prioritize small, high-impact fixes before next deploy window. This is my scratchpad for agenda + things I want called out live.
- Tone: concrete actions, owners, and unblockers. Avoid long design dives (save for separate deep-dive).

Meeting logistics:
- Duration: 30 minutes (standup-style)
- When: Wednesdays 11:00–11:30 PT (use this as recurring agenda)
- Attendees (core): Lena (me), Ben, Isha, Marc, optional: Priya, Arjun, Ops on-call

Agenda (30m):
1) 0–5m — Quick wins & shoutouts
   - Ben: KV-cache miss rate down 12% after last tweak? quick confirmation + link to metric
   - Isha: console deploy rollback yesterday — root cause summary (2 lines)
2) 5–12m — Latency KPIs (incidents & trends)
   - 95th/99th token-latency over past 24h (dataset: /metrics/latency/last-24h)
   - Noted spike 03/08 02:14 UTC — correlate with batch-scheduler change (RUNTIME-781)
   - Action: Marc to post short anomaly thread & initial hypothesis in #runtime-observability by EOD
3) 12–20m — Ops/infra blockers (deploys, capacity, fallbacks)
   - Dedicated pools: small regression in tail latency on p4d during burst — need repro steps (Ben)
   - Fallback policy test: verify fallback to 8-bit quantized variant still preserves 95th SLO; ask SRE to run smoke test on staging (Isha)
   - Autoscaler: investigate scaling delay when request queue floods >5s (open: INFRA-342)
4) 20–28m — Console / UX ask (quick hits)
   - Add a one-click view for per-model token-latency histogram (front-end ticket idea) — demo: Isha 1 min
   - Cost breakdown per-route: spike attribution currently confusing -> short-term text blurb in console explaining cost model
5) 28–30m — Actions, owners, calendar follow-ups

My live notes / scribbles (things I want to say):
- "If we can't repro p4d tail spike we should capture full NVTX trace from one affected job and upload to S3. Ben pls add job id to this doc."
- "Autoscaler: check both queue-length and avg-batch-size heuristics; maybe threshold tuning saved in config repo."
- "Console: short-term UX copy before full histogram tile is shipped — 1 sentence explaining smoothing and sample window (avoid folks misreading 99th)."

Action items (scratch list; I will formalize into JIRA after meeting):
- Ben: capture NVTX trace for 2026-03-08 p4d spike, upload to s3://redwood-debug/latency/traces/, add link to INFRA-342. Due: 2026-03-11.
- Marc: create anomaly-thread in #runtime-observability with initial hypothesis + link to charts. Due: today EOD (2026-03-09).
- Isha: run fallback smoke test (quantized-8bit) on staging and post results + sample prompt set. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Lena (me): consolidate meeting actions into RUNTIME-781 and assign owners; follow up with SRE for autoscaler log retention increase. Due: 2026-03-13.
- UX: Isha to draft 1-sentence console copy and drop PR to console repo for review. Due: 2026-03-16.

Parking lot (deeper follow-ups, schedule separately):
- Deep-dive: batching algorithm choices and impact on 99th for mixed request lengths (schedule 60m next sprint). Owners: me + Ben + research.
- Postmortem draft template for tail-latency events — propose a lightweight template for infra incidents.

Open questions (to surface in meeting):
- Is the p4d regression isolated to a single model family or wide? (Ben)
- Do we have stable repro traffic shape to run a controlled experiment vs. live traffic? (Marc)
- Can console show a smoothed vs raw toggle for latency histograms without backend changes? (Isha)

Links / quick references (for call):
- Latency dashboard (grafana): https://grafana.redwood.local/d/latency-overview
- INFRA-342 (autoscaler delay): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-342
- RUNTIME-781 (batch scheduler change): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RUNTIME-781
- PR draft for perf tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1294

Personal to-dos after sync (private):
- Draft short note to execs if we see continued tail regression >2 days (keep it 3 bullets).
- Reserve time Thursday morning to run local microbench with quantized variant (2h).
- Remind product about feature toggle for fallback policies in console (small ask).

Notes on tone / what I want from others:
- Short, concrete status updates. If something needs design time, call it out and move to separate F2F.
- When assigning, add an explicit due date in Jira PR/issue.

Rough edit history (cache of my edits):
- 2026-03-09 initial outline
- 2026-03-10 added action owners and links
- 2026-03-12 refined meeting questions after pager review

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a formal agenda doc if this passes quick ack from Ben/Isha.
